title: Durable, but not convenient.
text:
Durable, but not convenient.. It was easy to put together. It also fits in my cabinet well.

I don't like that you can't put newer cans in the back of the 2 lower shelves. It would be nice if the shelves would roll from the top to the lower shelf so that the newer items would be in the back and the older items would be used first. It still saves space, just not convenient.
